resources.name: Crisis Lifeline (988)
resources.description: Free, confidential, 24/7 support from trained counselors
resources.fullDescription: The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides free and confidential support to people in suicidal crisis or emotional distress. Available 24/7, you can talk to a trained crisis counselor anytime.
resources.bestFor: Suicidal thoughts, emotional crisis, depression, anxiety

resources.name: Emergency Services (911)
resources.description: For immediate danger to self or others
resources.fullDescription: If your child or you are in immediate danger, experiencing suicidal thoughts you plan to act on, or experiencing a mental health crisis, call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room immediately.
resources.bestFor: Immediate danger, active suicidal intent, severe crisis

resources.name: Care Solace
resources.description: Find local counselors and therapists near you
resources.fullDescription: Care Solace helps you find and connect with mental health professionals in your area. Get support in finding a counselor or therapist that matches your needs and insurance.
resources.bestFor: Finding long-term therapy, counselor matching, ongoing treatment

resources.name: Say Something
resources.fullDescription: Say Something is a national initiative that empowers students to see the signs of crisis in their peers and report concerns to a trusted adult. By asking for help, you can prevent tragedies before they happen.
resources.bestFor: Crisis prevention, peer support, school community engagement

resources.name: 7 Cups - Free Peer Support
resources.description: Free emotional support from trained listeners
resources.fullDescription: 7 Cups offers free, confidential conversations with trained emotional support listeners. No cost, no accounts, completely anonymous chat support available 24/7.
resources.bestFor: Anonymous peer support, affordable mental health access, loneliness, stress

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Free, confidential 24/7 referral and information service
resources.fullDescription: SAMHSA's National Helpline is a free, confidential, 24/7 treatment referral and information service. Completely free support for mental health and substance use issues.
resources.bestFor: Treatment referrals, information, free resources, substance use support

resources.name: NAMI Helpline - Free Mental Health Support
resources.description: Free peer support for mental health conditions
resources.fullDescription: NAMI (National Alliance on Mental Illness) offers free, confidential support via phone/text. Staffed by people with lived experience of mental illness.
resources.bestFor: Mental health info, peer support, understanding conditions

resources.name: CBT-i Coach (Free App)
resources.description: Free app for anxiety, insomnia, depression
resources.fullDescription: Free government-backed app using Cognitive Behavioral Therapy techniques for insomnia, anxiety, and depression. Download on any smartphone.
resources.bestFor: Self-directed anxiety/depression/insomnia treatment, accessible mental health

resources.name: Sliding Scale & Low-Cost Therapy
resources.description: Find affordable therapy in your area
resources.fullDescription: Many therapists offer sliding scale fees based on income. Psychology Today, TherapyDen, and GoodTherapy allow you to filter by cost. Also check IFCC (Institute for Family-Centered Care) directories.
resources.bestFor: Affordable long-term therapy, access for uninsured/underinsured

resources.name: Free Mental Health Apps & Meditation
resources.description: Free meditation and mental health content
resources.fullDescription: Headspace, Calm, Insight Timer offer free trials or free tiers with meditation, mindfulness, and sleep guidance. YouTube has thousands of free guided exercises.
resources.bestFor: Meditation, sleep support, daily stress management, anxiety

resources.name: School Counselor or Nurse
resources.description: Free mental health support at school
resources.fullDescription: Your school counselor or nurse can provide mental health screening, referrals, and support for free. This is one of the most accessible resources.
